_comment: Class names the CSS tree-shake in Build/Scripts/build-astryx-css.mjs must keep even though nothing it can scan renders them. It already scans every Fluid component, the 250 element templates, the page and Solr templates, every element stylesheet, Resources/Public/Js/astryx.js and the compiled upstream theme rules — so a name belongs here only when it is genuinely unscannable: a class a script composes from fragments at runtime, or one an editor can type into a rich-text field.
_rule: Every entry needs a reason. An entry without one is indistinguishable from dead weight a year later, which is exactly the state the tree-shake exists to end.
